sections.text: Return Relay and Associated Equipment to Service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( A2- A3 ) , ( A6 - A7 ) 
 , ( A10 - A11 ) 
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact ( A4 - A5 ).

Make sure CT and PT secondary circuits 
 are in normal condition.

If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The inverse time over current of IKC relays have been designed also for the 
detection of earth faults & leakage. The IKC911 relays are single phase and 
the IKC913 relay are three phase.
The 
first update initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin Hamdy & 
eng. Azza Salama , at 29 April 2008 , revised by MDEP Co.quality control eng. 
Adel El-Nagar , accepted by General Director eng.Mohamed Anber, and approved by 
eng. Farouk Awad Ali Head Sector of Talkha Power Station, coordinate eng. Samir 
Abd El gleel. Head sector of quality control eng.
Mohamed 
Nageeb.
Safety Precautions
Safety 
 fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
A work permit must be issued & 
 the staff of test must be qualified and carry the suitable safety 
 class (category).
Safety 
 fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
The auxiliary transformer must 
 be out of service.
Wear safety shoes.
Tools and Equipment
Test Plug handle,
Clamp ammeter,
Test leads,
Secondary injection test.
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make 
 sure CT secondary circuit are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolating the relay current circuit for test
Obtain copy of relay setting from 
 field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay.
Testing 
the Relay
Relays IKC911 
(Figure 1)
Connect test leads between the current terminals ( A2 A3 ).
Connect the test leads between the trip contact ( A4 A5 )
Increase 
 the current slowly until the relay picks up . ( I Start )
Record 
 the current values and the time values at each current value at which the 
 relay trips in the test sheet .
Increase 
 the current to the values ( 1 I start 2 I start & 3 I start ) .
Record 
 the current values and the time values at each current value at which the 
 relay trips in the test sheet .
Relays IKC913 
 (Figure 2)
Over Current Test
Repeat the step 
 no. 1 for phase R .
Connect the 
 test leads between the current terminals ( 6 7 ) for phase S.
Repeat the 
 steps from 2 to 6 for phase S .
Connect test 
 leads between the current terminals ( 10 11 ) for phase T .
Repeat the 
 steps from 2 to 6 for phase T .
Short Circuit Test
For phase R ( A2 A3 ) increase 
 the current quickly to high value until the relay trips instantaneously
Record the 
 current value in the test sheet .
For phase S ( A6 A7 ) repeat the 
 steps 12 & 13 .
For phase T ( A10 A11 ) repeat 
 steps 12 & 13 .
Return Relay and Associated Equipment to Service
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( A2- A3 ) , ( A6 - A7 ) 
 , ( A10 - A11 ) 
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact ( A4 - A5 ).
Make sure CT and PT secondary circuits 
 are in normal condition.
If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.
